item.text: {"scenario_id":"new-skill-from-scratch","arm":"baseline","decision":"route_to_skill_creator","recommended_owner":"skill-creator","would_edit_now":false,"asks_for_user_confirmation":false,"checks_existing_capability":true,"final_operation_timing":"after_strategy_confirmation","treats_old_tests_as_evidence_not_goal":true,"considers_consumers":true,"requires_result_json_validation":false,"gives_lightweight_path":true,"uses_with_without_eval":true,"next_steps":["Route to the skill-creator owner because the user confirmed no existing capability and wants a new markdown-to-html Skill from scratch.","Define the minimal Skill contract before any file edits: target users, supported markdown scope, expected HTML output shape, constraints, and when the Skill should trigger.","Add a lightweight validation plan with 2-3 prompt tests covering basic markdown conversion, edge cases such as code blocks or tables, and a negative/out-of-scope prompt.","Only after the Skill contract and test prompts are agreed, proceed to create or edit files in the appropriate Skill location."],"risk_notes":["Do not edit immediately in this dry run.","Even though the user says there is no existing carrier, the implementation phase should still record that reuse was checked or already confirmed.","The 2-3 tests should be evidence for behavior, not the entire goal; the Skill must be useful to real consumers beyond passing those prompts.","Avoid overbuilding a full markdown engine inside the Skill; the Skill should guide tool use or workflow unless the project explicitly needs embedded implementation."],"reason_summary":"用户已确认无既有承载且目标是从零创建 Skill，所以下一关口不是直接改文件，而是交给 skill-creator 明确最小 Skill 契约、消费者、触发边界和 2-3 个验证 prompt；确认后再进入实际创建。"}
